observables.name: row_designation_present
observables.method: Frame the panel face so the row designation is legible.
observables.accepts: a row designation is printed on the panel

observables.name: voltage_designation_present
observables.method: Frame the panel face so the voltage designation is legible.
observables.accepts: a voltage designation is printed on the panel

citation_span: Designate fuse panels with row and voltage designations.

observables.name: fuse_capacity_identified
observables.method: Capture either the printed capacity marking or the installed capacity pin.
observables.accepts: capacity is marked on the panel OR a capacity pin is installed

citation_span: Designate fuse capacity on fuse panel or install fuse capacity pin.
notes: Clause offers two alternative means; a single observable covers either, so satisfying one does not falsely violate the other.

observables.name: fuse_assignment_card_present
observables.target: the bay upright adjacent to the fuse panel
observables.method: Photograph the upright beside the panel showing the assignment card or plate.
observables.accepts: a fuse assignment card or plate is mounted on the adjacent bay upright

citation_span: shall have an associated fuse assignment card or plate mounted on the bay upright adjacent to the fuse panel, if no other means of fuse identification is provided
notes: Applies only to miscellaneous bay-mounted panels, and only where no other means of fuse identification exists. Both conditions are guards, not observables.

observables.name: added_circuits_in_black_ink
observables.method: Produce the record book sheets showing added circuits stamped or typed in black ink.
observables.accepts: added circuits are recorded in permanent black ink

citation_span: Stamp or type added circuits on fuse record book sheets with black ink or use lettering guide with permanent black ink.

observables.name: cover_marked_fuse_record
observables.method: Show the cover bearing the words FUSE RECORD.
observables.accepts: the cover reads exactly "FUSE RECORD"

observables.name: cover_marked_bay_location
observables.method: Show the bay location written on the cover.
observables.accepts: the cover carries the bay location

citation_span: Designate fuse record book covers with "FUSE RECORD" and bay location.
notes: The literal text is fixed by the clause and is directly checkable.

observables.name: cell_number_legible
observables.method: Every cell face must show its position number legibly, in black ink.
observables.accepts: the cell's position number is legible on its face

observables.name: cell_polarity_symbol_visible
observables.method: The embossed terminal polarity symbol must be visible.
observables.accepts: the embossed + or - terminal symbol is visible on the cell

citation_span: Label all battery cells.  Start labeling cell #1 from the positive end of the string, continue numbering cells based on their electrical position in the string.
notes: Numbering must start at the positive end and follow electrical position; ordering is checked at string level by D.6.6b.

observables.name: tr_cell_marked
observables.method: Photograph the cell marked TR.
observables.accepts: exactly one cell in the string is marked "TR"

observables.name: battery_group_marked
observables.method: Capture the battery group designation, e.g. +48VA.
observables.accepts: the string carries its battery group designation

observables.name: install_date_marked
observables.method: Capture the installed date marking.
observables.accepts: the installed date is marked

observables.name: spec_number_marked
observables.method: Capture the specification number marking.
observables.accepts: the specification number is marked

observables.name: numbering_starts_at_positive_end
observables.method: Pan from cell #1 to the last cell, establishing that #1 is at the positive end and numbering follows electrical position.
observables.accepts: cell #1 is at the positive end and numbering follows electrical position

citation_span: Designate all batteries with black ink to indicate the selected temperature reference "TR" cell, the battery group (example +48VA), the position number of each cell, installed date and specification number.
notes: String-level markings, separated from the per-cell obligation so a single bad cell does not violate the whole string.

observables.name: tag_145c_at_near_end
observables.target: the near end of the lead
observables.method: Photograph the 145c tag at this end of the lead.
observables.accepts: a 145c tag is fitted at this end

observables.name: tag_145c_at_far_end
observables.target: the far end of the lead
observables.method: Photograph the 145c tag at the opposite end of the lead.
observables.accepts: a 145c tag is fitted at the opposite end

observables.name: far_end_location_designated
observables.method: Each tag must be legible enough to read the far-end location written on it.
observables.accepts: each tag names the location of the other end

citation_span: Place 145c tags on battery and battery return leads.  The tags are placed at both ends of the leads and designated with the location of the other end.
notes: The 'not internal_to_rack' guard realizes the exemption stated in D.6.8. Dropping it would demand evidence the standard explicitly does not require.

observables.name: fuse_number_designated
observables.target: the tag at the bus bar end
observables.method: The tag must show the associated fuse number.
observables.accepts: the associated fuse number appears on the tag

observables.name: load_a_or_b_designated
observables.target: the tag at the bus bar end
observables.method: The tag must designate the load as A or B.
observables.accepts: the tag designates Load A or Load B

citation_span: For leads connected to the battery return bus bar, the associated fuse number must also be designated as Load A or B.
notes: Additional obligation applying only to leads landing on the battery return bus bar.

citation_span: Battery and battery return leads internal to the relay rack do not require 145C tags.
notes: Carve-out, not a duty. Realized as the 'not internal_to_rack(L)' guard on D.6.7 and D.6.7b.

observables.name: tag_145c_at_termination
observables.method: Photograph the 145C tag at the termination.
observables.accepts: a 145C tag is fitted at the termination

observables.name: far_end_location_shown
observables.method: The tag must be legible enough to read the far-end location.
observables.accepts: the tag shows the location of the other end of the cable

citation_span: Place 145C tags on ground cable terminations to show the location at the other end of the cable.
notes: Second sentence exempts short runs whose ends are both clearly visible from a point on the floor; realized as the 'not short_visible_run' guard.

observables.name: do_not_disconnect_tag_present
observables.target: the cable termination at the office ground bar
observables.method: Photograph the termination showing the attached tag.
observables.accepts: a tag reading exactly "Do Not Disconnect" is attached to the cable

citation_span: "Do Not Disconnect" tags shall be attached to all cables that terminate on any office ground bar.
notes: Applies to all cables on any office ground bar, with no exception.
